reporting_party: steward tax office with subject representative review
tax_characterization: gross digital-service revenue belongs to deployer unless separately allocated to subject revenue account; redress and emergency compute are not operating profit
withholding_or_information_reporting: broker/payment processor reporting reviewed for Form 1099-DA or other information reporting only if asset disposition occurs
privacy_minimization: tax file includes value/account facts, not welfare notes, formation history, or sealed continuity locators
non_evasion_analysis: company cannot shift deployment revenue or penalties to dependent subject; subject account cannot be used to hide steward revenue
appeal_or_correction_route: representative may request correction before filing and appeal post-filing allocation errors
public_summary: Tax posture prevents both company evasion and dependent-subject tax dumping.
